reviews.title: Underrated case
reviews.comment: This thing is great to look at and super easy to build in, especially if you've only built in small cases before. Glass looks fantastic.
reviews.author: Nate

reviews.title: Looks great and does its job well.
reviews.comment: After using this for some time, I will have to say that this is a beautiful and functional case. The smooth contours, and ease of installing components was flawless. It hides almost everything I do not want to see and adding the LED fans makes it a work of art instead of a boring lump. Quality of this case was very nice. No sharp edges, everything lines up and it just works as I hoped it would. Case cooling is important to me and it has plenty of space for coolers, fans and components. I am very happy with this case.
reviews.author: Glenn T.

reviews.title: Fish tank
reviews.comment: Works perfect, was incredibly simple to install everything and looks beautiful, it's just... Really... Really big. Returned it for a SFF build. It was far harder to install and work with but in the end you only really need to do it once or twice. 🤷‍♂️
reviews.author: Patrick C

reviews.title: Excellent case!
reviews.comment: An excellent dual chambered case that was very easy to build in and has excellent air flow. If you remove the HDD bracket as well, cable management in the back chamber is a complete non-issue. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: MartinReviews

reviews.title: Beautiful and useful
reviews.comment: Great construction and better airflow from the bottom than the TK-2
